about: Cognition-authored IELTS Speaking Part 1 topic frames (COGNITION_AUTHORED_PRACTICE). Written in the IELTS Part 1 format: short, personal questions on familiar everyday topics. Not official IELTS/Cambridge material. Each package gets 1 introductory frame + 2 everyday frames (4 questions each). 'avoidIfTopicMatches' is a case-insensitive regex tested against the Part 2 topic so Part 1 never pre-empts Part 2; frames sharing a 'family' are never used together in one package.
